items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I’m lucky enough to have a steady weekend jazz job, Holly Hoffman, who is a wonderful flute player, lives in San Diego, and Mike Wofford the pianist

ctx.x: What’s in the near future for you? Playing with your grandchildren?

Yeah, doing that a lot. I’m lucky enough to have a steady weekend jazz job, Holly Hoffman, who is a wonderful flute player, lives in San Diego, and Mike Wofford the pianist, and then Jim Plank had been doing it and he’s been — we got our symphony back. I don’t know if you heard our symphony went belly up.
